The main takeaway from our work is that
we have shown for the first time that rapid rate rTMS of the motor cortex leads to spread of excita tion to other muscles, which is dependent on the rTMs frequency and intensity.

rTMS can be used to induce a spread of excitation from the primary motor cortex to other regions in the motor system, and this may be useful in the study of the functional organization and the plastic changes occurring within the motor system.
